rebuttal_or_critique: While I acknowledge the arguments for a neutral stance based on core inflation moderation, the headline CPI at 4.85% remains uncomfortably above our 4.00% target. The persistence of food inflation at 8.52% and the positive output gap of 0.40% indicate that the disinflationary process is not yet complete. Prematurely shifting the stance could signal a premature easing of our commitment to price stability, potentially unanchoring inflation expectations. I remain committed to the withdrawal of accommodation to ensure the durability of the disinflationary path, though I remain open to reviewing the stance in future meetings as incoming data provides more clarity on the durability of the moderation in inflation.
